id: \rIt doesn't matter. I'm just glad you were able to distract Team Rocket. Thanks to you I was able to heal Cresselia.
en: \rIt doesn't matter. I'm just glad you were able to distract Team Rocket. Thanks to you I was able to heal Cresselia.
it: \rNon importa. Sono solo contenta che tu sia riuscito a distrarre il Team Rocket. Grazie a te sono riuscita a curare Cresselia.

id: \rI think Darkrai was trying to protect it from Team Rocket. Now they can both return to Fullmoon Island.
en: \rI think Darkrai was trying to protect it from Team Rocket. Now they can both return to Fullmoon Island.
it: \rCredo che Darkrai cercasse di proteggerla dal Team Rocket. Ora possono tornare entrambi sull'Isola Lunapiena.

id: \rI bet you were expecting a battle with it, weren't you? Don't worry, I have you covered.
en: \rI bet you were expecting a battle with it, weren't you? Don't worry, I have you covered.
it: \rScommetto che ti aspettavi di lottare con lei, vero? Tranquillo, ci penso io.

id: \rDawn: That was fun. It was good to unwind and do something relaxing. Let's do it again one day.
en: \rDawn: That was fun. It was good to unwind and do something relaxing. Let's do it again one day.
it: \rLucinda: È stato divertente. Mi ha fatto bene staccare e fare qualcosa di rilassante. Rifacciamolo un giorno.

id: \bGoh: I'm glad it all worked out. Let's head back to the lab.
en: \bGoh: I'm glad it all worked out. Let's head back to the lab.
it: \bGoh: Sono contento che sia andato tutto bene. Torniamo al laboratorio.

id: \rMatori: You won't stop us this time.
en: \rMatori: You won't stop us this time.
